data_quality.title: Contract/price values differ inside the workbook
data_quality.detail: Dashboard. Total Contract Price = EGP 385,466,379.00; 1. Project Summary Total Price = EGP 386,004,399.00; difference = EGP 538,020.00. Direct Details modified total is EGP 386,004,406.20.

data_quality.title: Earned Value has different scopes
data_quality.detail: Dashboard EV = EGP 159,851,272.42; Total Project EV = EGP 179,811,680.53. The wider total includes the Fees & Sponsorship EV layer, so they must be labelled, not merged.

data_quality.title: Actual Cost has different scopes
data_quality.detail: Dashboard Actual Cost = EGP 115,396,781.52; Total Project Actual Cost = EGP 120,267,994.81. The latter includes Fees & Sponsorship actual cost of EGP 4,871,213.29.

data_quality.title: Detailed ledger is EGP 43.4k above dashboard accounting scope
data_quality.detail: Expenses ledger total = EGP 115,440,181.31; Dashboard Actual Cost = EGP 115,396,781.52; gap = EGP 43,399.79.

data_quality.title: Forecast formulas contain broken references
data_quality.detail: 1. Project Summary contains 16 #REF! cells in the Indirect and Fees/Sponsorship forecast totals. These are shown as unavailable, never forced to zero.

data_quality.title: Expense ledger contains formula errors outside the current monthly actual block
data_quality.detail: The workbook contains 7 expense-sheet formula errors (#DIV/0! / #REF!) in later template/forecast columns. Current Jul-2025 to Jun-2026 actual monthly totals are retained separately.

data_quality.title: Balance storage and Fixed Assets are not populated this period
data_quality.detail: Fixed Assets is effectively an empty template. Balance storage rows are blank and their lookup cells show #N/A. The UI marks these as data gaps rather than zero-valued assets/inventory.

data_quality.title: Three profitability methods coexist
data_quality.detail: Revenue-based GP, EV-based Net Profit, and Planned GP use different bases and deductions. The dashboard compares them side-by-side and does not select or average them.

data_quality.title: Project commencement dates conflict inside the workbook
data_quality.detail: 0.Cover Sheet shows Project Commencement Date = 11-Sep-2026, while the visible Dashboard sheet shows Start Date = 11-Sep-2025. Both are preserved and neither is silently replaced.

data_quality.title: Expense ledger month header contains a date anomaly
data_quality.detail: Expenses ( Actual Cost ) row 2 places 01-Aug-2026 between Jul-2025 and Sep-2025. The dashboard preserves the source header exactly and flags it for review.

data_quality.title: Cashflow total and detailed expense ledger are not identical
data_quality.detail: Cashflow sheet total Cashout-AC = EGP 115,445,747.69; detailed Expenses ledger total = EGP 115,440,181.31. Difference = EGP 5,566.39.
